environment.description: Node.js 18 migration service running in a Docker container with default security settings. Container runs as root with no MAC enforcement. The service is exposed on port 3000 within the internal network. Migrations directory is /app/migrations, completion markers written to /var/lib/migrations/completed. Process has full filesystem access.

config.security_modules: none (AppArmor in complain mode, effectively disabled)
config.filesystem: full read/write access to container filesystem
config.network: internal network, port 3000 exposed to other services
